attempts.summary: Deployed a Python-based inventory application on node1, serving JSON inventory data over TCP port 8181, confined by a dedicated AppArmor (mandatory access control) profile in enforce mode. Verified the profile actively denies unintended file access (real DENIED audit entries) while still serving requests correctly, confirming MAC enforcement is genuine, not decorative. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured a healthy baseline (boot_id, AppArmor enforce status, service state, HTTP health), issued a native systemd reboot, polled until the node was reachable again, and proved the boot_id changed and all required state (AppArmor enforcing, systemd service active/enabled, HTTP endpoint on 8181) recovered post-restart.
